body:
Support me on [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/cw/Ninjabrain)

## Improvements
* Improved macOS support by @Slackow
  * Application icon shows up in dock
  * Application name shows up as NinjabrainBot instead of "Main"
  * Hotkeys show up with their proper names
  * Numpad keys are now treated as distinct keys on Mac/Linux
  * Added support for reading the active Minecraft world (for automatic resetting and switching to advancement mode)
* Support parsing version numbers in Minecraft 26.1+ by @Slackow
* Add support for reading the active Minecraft instance when using prism launcher on Windows by @Slackow
* Marginally improve precision when throwing an eye at a block corner by @char3210
* Allow raw keycodes on linux and mac when the normal keycode fails by @Flintley
* Add information messages to the API
* Add number of correction increments to the API by @AndrewDTR
* Reduce OBS overlay update timer

## Fixes
* Fix information messages not showing up in a loaded save state on startup
* Fix all advancements structures not inputting if boat is blue
* Support clipboard reading in 1.13 by @tildejustin
* Fix display of certain hotkeys on Windows that would previously show as e.g. "0xba" by @myerDOT
* Add CORS headers to API by @AndrewDTR

## Language
* Added Portuguese (Portugal) language by @batatasmor
* Fixed various typos in Brazilian Portuguese by @pedrotelesh
* Fix crash in polish translation by @kojonek2 and @tene38, fixes #125
* Update Chinese translations  by @Crsuh2er0 
* Fix Russian translation by @PukPukov

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Ninjabrain1/Ninjabrain-Bot/compare/1.5.1...1.5.2
